response:
关闭“填写明细”时，明细字段会隐藏，但仍保留 `$detail` 的值；隐藏期间它不参与必填校验。提交按钮只会生成一份可编辑的检查草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form, ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle, nameField, detailField], title="公司发票信息")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="填写明细")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="公司名称", required=true)
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="发票明细", required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(action=Ask(text="请检查此公司发票表单；以下内容是可编辑草稿，尚未发送。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}), form=form, label="准备检查草稿")
```
